tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Use this instead of Grep to search the team's published documentation: runbooks, API guides and architecture notes that are not in the repository. Use it when the question is about how a service behaves or how to operate it, and use Grep for code in the checkout. It takes a plain-language query such as 'refund retry policy' or an exact page title, and returns up to ten matches, each with the page title, a link and a short excerpt. It does not search the source code, and it does not return whole pages: open a link for that. Extra detail. Extra detail. Extra detail. Extra detail. Extra detail. Extra detail. Extra detail.
